page: Microsoft Azure M32ls is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the MS family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processor operating at 2.7 GHz, configured with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via hyper-threading. The hardware includes 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For storage, the instance is equipped with 1049 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable. It does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor provides a 105 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. Supported instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA, though it lacks newer extensions such as AMX and AVX512_VNNI. Performance benchmarks indicate a clear tradeoff between single-core and multi-core execution. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng, Geekbench, and single-threaded compression, consistently fall into the bottom 10% tier. Conversely, multi-core operations, such as multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests, achieve average performance within the middle 50% tier.

Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks register in the average range, as does the Passmark memory score. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput also align with the middle 50% benchmark tier. For machine learning tasks, the instance handles prompt processing and text generation for small and medium models at average speeds, but drops to the bottom 10% for large model prompt processing. Given the 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio and average multi-threaded and database performance, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded speed, such as relational databases, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
description: The Microsoft Azure M32ls is an x86_64 server instance in the MS family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 32 vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 256.0 GB of RAM, and 1049 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. While single-core performance benchmarks for this instance fall into the bottom 10%, its multi-core capabilities, memory bandwidth, and database operations consistently perform in the average middle 50% tier. The instance lacks GPU acceleration and newer instruction sets like AMX, but supports AVX, AVX512F, and AES. With an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio, the M32ls is suited for memory-optimized workloads, database hosting, caching layers, and multi-threaded enterprise applications that benefit from high memory capacity rather than peak single-core CPU speeds.
